test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Her sudden __arrival__ has disarranged my plans.
solution: The correct answer is '**Departure**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Arrival**' is '**Departure**'. • **Arrival**: reaching the place to which you were travelling. [(किसी स्‍थान पर) आगमन, पहुँच] • *Example: We were told our rooms had not been reserved on our **arrival**.* • **Departure**: leaving or going away from a place. (प्रस्‍थान क्रिया, रवानगी) • *Example: Passengers should check in at least one hour before **departure**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Departure.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Timing**: the time when something is planned to happen. (कुछ करने या घटित होने के लिए निर्धारित समय; समय-निर्धारण) • **Entrance**: the door, gate, or opening where you go into a place. (प्रवेश द्वार) • **Appearance**: the way that somebody/something looks or seems. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु का बाहरी रूप; रूप-रंग) 32:T18c2, The correct answer is** 'BADC'.**
